about: the Royal Rumble freeze (2026-10-27): a model made as the match goes on has its palettes packed, and the game's skin colours went over the end of one of its display lists (skel.c pal_group_guard). Every entrant one brought over from another game (qa_rr_ports), entrants every 10 s; Bret the player, the CPU fighting for him, his back suplex from back grapples (qa_bsuplex)

expect.name: the Rumble started
expect.check: stage == 2 and mode == -2 and match_frames != 0xFFFF and match_frames > 30

expect.name: Bret Hart is in it
expect.check: s0_id == 0x060D or s1_id == 0x060D or s2_id == 0x060D or s3_id == 0x060D

expect.name: no model's matrices ever went bad
every palette had No Mercy's room (the guard never needed: gen/nmpal.py)
